title: Is There a Way to Sober Up Faster?
speaker: SciShow
zh: 【SciShow】有沒有辦法可以更快醒酒？（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: If you drink alcohol, you’ve probably heard some tips and tricks for getting sober faster.
cues.en: If you drink alcohol, you’ve probably heard some tips and tricks for getting sober faster.
cues.zh: 如果您喝酒，您可能聽說過一些更快清醒的提示和技巧。

cues.text: Unfortunately, there is nothing most of us can do other than wait it out.
cues.en: Unfortunately, there is nothing most of us can do other than wait it out.
cues.zh: 不幸的是，除了等待，我們大多數人無能為力。

cues.text: But scientists recently figured out something that might help, at least in a clinical setting:
cues.en: But scientists recently figured out something that might help, at least in a clinical setting:
cues.zh: 但科學家最近發現了一些可能有幫助的東西，至少在臨床環境中：

cues.text: They have found a way to breathe the booze out.
cues.en: They have found a way to breathe the booze out.
cues.zh: 他們找到了一個方法來撥出酒氣。

cues.text: And while it won’t help you after a night on the town, it does have the serious potential to save lives.
cues.en: And while it won’t help you after a night on the town, it does have the serious potential to save lives.
cues.zh: 雖然在鎮上度過一夜後它對你沒有幫助，但它確實具有拯救生命的巨大潛力。

cues.text: So when we drink, alcohol in the form of ethanol goes from our guts into our bloodstream.
cues.en: So when we drink, alcohol in the form of ethanol goes from our guts into our bloodstream.
cues.zh: 因此，當我們喝酒時，酒精以乙醇的形式從我們的腸道進入我們的血液。

cues.text: And from there, it affects our brains, circulation, and all sorts of other systems that make us, you know, feel drunk.
cues.en: And from there, it affects our brains, circulation, and all sorts of other systems that make us, you know, feel drunk.
cues.zh: 從那裡開始，它會影響我們的大腦、血液迴圈和各種其他系統，使我們，你知道，感到醉酒。

cues.text: Then, our livers sober us up by converting the alcohol into another compound.
cues.en: Then, our livers sober us up by converting the alcohol into another compound.
cues.zh: 然後，我們的肝臟透過將酒精轉化為另一種化合物來使我們清醒。

cues.text: 90 percent of the ethanol in our bodies is cleared through the liver, and to this day, we have not been able to speed that process up.
cues.en: 90 percent of the ethanol in our bodies is cleared through the liver, and to this day, we have not been able to speed that process up.
cues.zh: 我們體內 90% 的乙醇是經由肝臟清除的，直到今天，我們還無法加快這個過程。

cues.text: But there is another way to get alcohol out of your blood: exhaling it.
cues.en: But there is another way to get alcohol out of your blood: exhaling it.
cues.zh: 但還有另一種方法可以將酒精從血液中排出：呼氣。

cues.text: See, if there’s a greater concentration of some gas in your blood than in your lungs,
cues.en: See, if there’s a greater concentration of some gas in your blood than in your lungs,
cues.zh: 看，如果你的血液中某些氣體的濃度比你肺部的濃度高，

cues.text: you’ll start to breathe that gas out.
cues.en: you’ll start to breathe that gas out.
cues.zh: 你會開始撥出這些氣體。

cues.text: This is actually why we breathe out carbon dioxide.
cues.en: This is actually why we breathe out carbon dioxide.
cues.zh: 這其實就是我們撥出二氧化碳的原因。

cues.text: The tiny blood vessels around our lungs called capillaries have a higher concentration of
cues.en: The tiny blood vessels around our lungs called capillaries have a higher concentration of
cues.zh: 我們肺部周圍的微小血管（稱為毛細血管）含有較高濃度的

cues.text: carbon dioxide than in the air in our lungs.
cues.en: carbon dioxide than in the air in our lungs.
cues.zh: 我們肺部的二氧化碳比空氣中的二氧化碳還要多。

cues.text: That difference is enough to make the CO2 travel into the lungs and eventually, out of our mouths and noses.
cues.en: That difference is enough to make the CO2 travel into the lungs and eventually, out of our mouths and noses.
cues.zh: 這種差異足以使二氧化碳進入肺部，並最終從我們的嘴和鼻子中排出。

cues.text: The same is true of ethanol.
cues.en: The same is true of ethanol.
cues.zh: 乙醇也是如此。

cues.text: If it’s at a higher concentration in someone’s blood than in the air, they will breathe it out.
cues.en: If it’s at a higher concentration in someone’s blood than in the air, they will breathe it out.
cues.zh: 如果某人血液中的濃度高於空氣中的濃度，他們就會將其撥出。

cues.text: This is why breathalyzers work.
cues.en: This is why breathalyzers work.
cues.zh: 這就是呼氣分析儀起作用的原因。

cues.text: Now, if you’re thinking that to sober up, you just need to breathe a bunch, you don’t want to go down that road.
cues.en: Now, if you’re thinking that to sober up, you just need to breathe a bunch, you don’t want to go down that road.
cues.zh: 現在，如果你認為要清醒，你只需要深呼吸，你就不想走那條路。

cues.text: You’d probably pass out in a few minutes, because you wouldn’t just be breathing out
cues.en: You’d probably pass out in a few minutes, because you wouldn’t just be breathing out
cues.zh: 你可能會在幾分鐘內昏倒，因為你不只是在呼氣

cues.text: more ethanol, you would also be getting rid of too much CO2 too quickly.
cues.en: more ethanol, you would also be getting rid of too much CO2 too quickly.
cues.zh: 更多的乙醇，也會過快消除過多的二氧化碳。

cues.text: And while too much carbon dioxide can hurt us, too little causes our brains’ blood
cues.en: And while too much carbon dioxide can hurt us, too little causes our brains’ blood
cues.zh: 雖然太多的二氧化碳會傷害我們，但太少的二氧化碳會導致我們的大腦血液

cues.text: vessels to narrow, which deprives our brains of oxygen.
cues.en: vessels to narrow, which deprives our brains of oxygen.
cues.zh: 血管變窄，從而剝奪了我們大腦的氧氣。

cues.text: Still, that doesn’t mean the overall idea is useless.
cues.en: Still, that doesn’t mean the overall idea is useless.
cues.zh: 不過，這並不意味著整體想法毫無用處。

cues.text: In a 2020 paper from Scientific Reports, researchers came up with a simple, yet elegant way to make this work:
cues.en: In a 2020 paper from Scientific Reports, researchers came up with a simple, yet elegant way to make this work:
cues.zh: 在 Scientific Reports 2020 年的一篇論文中，研究人員提出了一種簡單而優雅的方法來完成這項工作：

cues.text: Just have people breathe in more CO2.
cues.en: Just have people breathe in more CO2.
cues.zh: 只是讓人們吸入更多的二氧化碳。

cues.text: In their study, they had volunteers drink vodka in the lab.
cues.en: In their study, they had volunteers drink vodka in the lab.
cues.zh: 在他們的研究中，他們讓志工在實驗室裡喝伏特加。

cues.text: Then, they hooked them up to a special breathing mask that supplied them with the same amount of carbon dioxide that they had in their capillaries.
cues.en: Then, they hooked them up to a special breathing mask that supplied them with the same amount of carbon dioxide that they had in their capillaries.
cues.zh: 然後，他們給它們戴上一個特殊的呼吸面罩，為它們提供與毛細血管中等量的二氧化碳。

cues.text: Essentially, they created equal concentrations of carbon dioxide in their lungs and in their bloodstreams.
cues.en: Essentially, they created equal concentrations of carbon dioxide in their lungs and in their bloodstreams.
cues.zh: 本質上，他們在肺部和血液中產生了相同濃度的二氧化碳。

cues.text: And as a result, the participants could breathe out ethanol while their CO2 levels didn’t budge.
cues.en: And as a result, the participants could breathe out ethanol while their CO2 levels didn’t budge.
cues.zh: 結果，參與者可以撥出乙醇，而他們的二氧化碳水平卻沒有變化。

cues.text: And sure enough, the participants who hyperventilated while hooked up to CO2 cleared ethanol from
cues.en: And sure enough, the participants who hyperventilated while hooked up to CO2 cleared ethanol from
cues.zh: 果然，那些在接觸二氧化碳時過度換氣的參與者清除了乙醇

cues.text: their bloodstream three times faster than when they sat around breathing normally without a mask.
cues.en: their bloodstream three times faster than when they sat around breathing normally without a mask.
cues.zh: 他們的血流速度比他們坐著、不戴口罩正常呼吸時的速度快三倍。

cues.text: Now, it’ll probably be a while before CO2 machines show up at your local bar, if they ever do.
cues.en: Now, it’ll probably be a while before CO2 machines show up at your local bar, if they ever do.
cues.zh: 現在，二氧化碳機器可能還需要一段時間才會出現在您當地的酒吧（如果有的話）。

cues.text: But the bigger point is that this method might actually be especially useful for alcohol overdoses.
cues.en: But the bigger point is that this method might actually be especially useful for alcohol overdoses.
cues.zh: 但更重要的一點是，這種方法實際上可能對酒精過量特別有用。

cues.text: Right now, our best alternative is dialysis, which is literally filtering and cleaning blood with a machine,
cues.en: Right now, our best alternative is dialysis, which is literally filtering and cleaning blood with a machine,
cues.zh: 目前，我們最好的選擇是透析，這實際上是用機器過濾和清潔血液，

cues.text: which might not be immediately available in an emergency.
cues.en: which might not be immediately available in an emergency.
cues.zh: 在緊急情況下可能無法立即使用。

cues.text: So, this new finding could give first responders another tool to help folks get alcohol out
cues.en: So, this new finding could give first responders another tool to help folks get alcohol out
cues.zh: 因此，這項新發現可以為急救人員提供另一種工具來幫助人們擺脫酒精

cues.text: of their systems faster, and save some lives along the way.
cues.en: of their systems faster, and save some lives along the way.
cues.zh: 更快地改進他們的系統，並在過程中拯救一些生命。

cues.text: Thanks for asking! If you have a science question for us, let us know in the comments.
cues.en: Thanks for asking! If you have a science question for us, let us know in the comments.
cues.zh: 謝謝你的詢問！如果您有科學問題要問我們，請在評論中告訴我們。

cues.text: Or, if you’re a patron, you can leave it on our Patreon QQ inbox to make sure we see it.
cues.en: Or, if you’re a patron, you can leave it on our Patreon QQ inbox to make sure we see it.
cues.zh: 或者，如果您是訂閱會員，您可以將其留在我們的 Patreon QQ 收件匣中，以確保我們能夠看到。

cues.text: Also if you want to learn more about the science of alcohol, you can watch our episode on SciShow Psych about how different types of alcohol affect our emotions.
cues.en: Also if you want to learn more about the science of alcohol, you can watch our episode on SciShow Psych about how different types of alcohol affect our emotions.
cues.zh: 另外，如果您想了解更多關於酒精的科學知識，您可以觀看我們在 SciShow Psych 上的劇集，以瞭解不同型別的酒精如何影響我們的情緒。
